company.name: Closure
company.shortDescription: Closure is a online platform for completing subscriptions, contracts and accounts after a death
company.description: Closure provides a day when everyone automatically completes their inheritance in the private sector, just like in the public sector. In order to achieve this, we strive to develop a platform that removes this pain from relatives.

productsAndServices.description: A service that helps organizations efficiently process death notifications and manage the termination, modification, or transfer of subscriptions and contracts of deceased individuals.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Driven Bereavement Subscription Management Service

productsAndServices.description: A platform that enables bereaved individuals to manage subscriptions across over 1600 organizations through a single interface, allowing cancellation, modification, or transfer of accounts.
productsAndServices.name: White Label Platform for Multi-Organization Subscription Management

productsAndServices.description: A service that collects and verifies death notification data from bereaved individuals via digital forms and telephone support, ensuring accurate processing of subscription changes.
productsAndServices.name: Digital and Telephonic Intake and Verification Service

productsAndServices.description: A digital platform that guides bereaved families through managing practical, financial, legal and digital affairs after a loved one’s death.
productsAndServices.name: Closure platform

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Closure combines White Label Platform for Multi-Organization Subscription Management with AI-Driven Bereavement Subscription Management Service.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $1,538,515, or 81.79% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,713,067 to $9,923,238, a 3.66x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 84 (-9 over 90 days) and market heat at 72 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include British Business Bank, Life Ledger, Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT).
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
